parsed.explanation: Private same-sex acts are lawful, but trans-specific exposure is high. Articles punish public indecency/same-sex acts and unequal consent give discretionary levers, while no gender-identity protections exist. Documented hostility targets feminine-presenting trans people: trans man beaten, LGBTQI+ deaths, 2024 influencer incitement and dozens of assaults, market attack causing withdrawal. Security forces previously raided bars, abused and extorted trans/effeminate people. Police are slow, victim-blaming, with many afraid to report; official rights statement exists but recourse is weak. No universal facility/custody rule or execution campaign is documented, and data lack visitor-specific cases; however, visible trans visitors who are outed face plausible assault/extortion and poor remedy. Extrapolating from institutional failure, not silence, places jurisdiction in high risk.
